I fixed `median` in `src/stats_utils.py`. I couldn't run the tests, because Bash was denied in this session. I only read the code.

For even-length lists, `median` returned the upper middle element. It now returns the average of the two middle elements, so `median([4, 1, 3, 2])` gives 2.5. That should fix `test_median_even`.

You said it "isn't working right" without saying what. This was the only bug I found, and the other tests look fine from reading them. If you meant something else, tell me what you saw. If you want me to run the tests, allow Bash.
